name: avatar-avatar-group-count
title: Avatar: Avatar Group Count
description: Use `<AvatarGroupCount>` to add a count to the group. It renders an avatar with a fallback, so it follows the group's size and uses the same clipped silhouette as the other members.

files.content:
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarGroup,
  AvatarGroupCount,
  AvatarImage,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/avatar";

export default function AvatarGroupCountExample() {
  return (
    <AvatarGroup className="grayscale">
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage
          src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/1681010/pexels-photo-1681010.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=256&h=256&fit=crop"
          alt="John Doe"
        />
        <AvatarFallback>JD</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage
          src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/415829/pexels-photo-415829.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=256&h=256&fit=crop"
          alt="Jane Doe"
        />
        <AvatarFallback>JD</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage
          src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/2379004/pexels-photo-2379004.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=256&h=256&fit=crop"
          alt="Alex Smith"
        />
        <AvatarFallback>AS</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
      <AvatarGroupCount>+3</AvatarGroupCount>
    </AvatarGroup>
  );
}
